Container.Name: EasyUploader
Container.Overview: Easy Uploader is a self-hosted file and photo sharing app. Create named share links protected by passwords. Guests visit the link, enter the password, and upload files or photos directly to your server. Manage all shares and view every upload from the admin panel.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Easy Uploader web interface.

Config.Name: Uploads Path
Config.Description: Where uploaded files are stored on your server. Map this to the share or folder where you want files to land.

Config.Name: Data Path
Config.Description: Where the database file is stored. Keep this on persistent storage.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Password for the admin panel. Required.

Config.Name: Session Secret
Config.Description: A long random string used to sign session cookies. Generate one at: https://generate-secret.vercel.app/64

Config.Name: Max File Size (MB)
Config.Description: Maximum size per uploaded file, in megabytes.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the container runs as. Use 99 for nobody (Unraid default).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the container runs as. Use 100 for users (Unraid default).
